_metadata.note: Every coordinate decision the generator made, counted; every correction it applied, listed with the source values it replaced. Ambiguous and invalid rows are in reports/facilities_quarantine_v1.json with their memberships. Nothing in this report was decided by a centroid or a median distance.

algorithm.instrument: k-nearest-neighbour state membership over the repository's GRID3 facility points; no polygons, no centroids, no median distances

reference_points.citation: GRID3 NGA Health Facilities v2.0 — CIESIN, Columbia University (2024), https://doi.org/10.7916/kv1n-0743, CC BY 4.0
reference_points.licence_basis: CC BY 4.0, recorded in facilities.ng.v1.1.json _metadata.sources and facilities/source_research.md; used here as reference geometry with attribution

membership.inside_strict: all k nearest GRID3 facilities are in the declared state and the nearest is within the radius
membership.inside_majority: the nearest is in the declared state and at least majority_min of k are; a facility near a state line
membership.outside: all k nearest are in other states, or the nearest facility of the declared state is beyond same_state_max_km

outcomes.accepted_unchanged: as given inside_strict; or inside_majority with the exchanged pair outside
outcomes.accepted_after_verified_swap: as given outside (or out of box) AND exchanged inside_strict; latitude and longitude are exchanged and the source values are kept on the record
outcomes.quarantined_ambiguous: both orientations plausible, either uncertain, or GRID3 records a different state for the same facility
outcomes.quarantined_invalid: both orientations outside the declared state

algorithm.determinism: neighbour ties break on (distance, state, OBJECTID); cells are visited in a fixed order; calibration uses a fixed subsample

grid3_record_level_corroboration.note: GRID3 carries the NHFR facility id, so the SAME facility's independently published point can be compared with each orientation. GRID3 is a different geocoding vintage, so agreement is loose; it corroborates the rule's direction and decided nothing.
